dwarf_producer_contract.policy: candidate verifier return code and error classes/counts must match the reference; DWARF5 must be clean; all reference debug sections must remain; split cases require one emitted DWO whose debug sections cover the reference DWO

expression_reference_contract.implementation: location writers reserve fixed-width base-type-reference operands during initial serialization and patch them after final DIE offsets are assigned; unknown expression tails remain raw and unchanged
